cards.body: Leaders: VRT +12.61%, PWR +7.80%, EOSE +6.04%, NXT +5.54%, ARRY +4.72%. Laggards: ENPH -16.33%, SEDG -8.89%, BKR -6.53%, NOV -6.23%.
